status: Primary-source formation research, strict editorial/key review, content/source/audio/preservation/browser/build and production offline gates passed; native review pending.
method: Full relevant sections of the two named publishers’ own lessons inspected for each form. Official N2 item aims inspected separately. All examples, essays, scenes and tasks are original.

points.formation: Attributive clause + 一方（で）; noun の / である; na-adjective な / である. Sentence-initial 一方で.
points.teachingChoice: Questions become easier while the film’s flow breaks; the other author proposes a different order.
points.sourceCaution: Two effects or approaches can be contrasted; do not impose a universal positive-negative order or claim mutually exclusive use with 反面.

points.formation: Attributive verb / i-adjective; na-adjective な / である; noun である + 反面. その反面 can introduce another clause.
points.teachingChoice: The author acknowledges reduced immersion as a cost of taking questions at breaks.
points.sourceCaution: Bunpro’s stronger positive-negative preference differs from IMABI’s examples. Teach these contextual effects, not an absolute semantic boundary.

points.formation: むしろ clause; X より（も）むしろ Y.
points.teachingChoice: Mori prefers watching the whole film first and clarifies that discussion is still wanted.
points.sourceCaution: Rather/preference or characterisation requires context; it is not merely an unexpected-outcome connector. No publisher examples copied.

points.formation: Attributive clause / na-adjective な / noun の + 点で; quoted description or noun phrase + という点で.
points.teachingChoice: Valuing questions is shared, while the time of pausing differs.
points.sourceCaution: A named aspect limits the agreement; it is not a guarantee of objective assessment or total agreement. Publisher labels do not establish an official JLPT form assignment.

testSkill.scope: The official N2 integrated-comprehension aim describes multiple texts totalling about 600 Japanese characters. These two longer supported essays are extended course practice, not an exact exam reproduction.

editorialReview.sceneChoice: Ordinary planning exchanges, with one contrast sentence explicitly quoted from Yui’s essay. No quota-driven headword insertion or invented cultural rules.
editorialReview.remaining: Whole N2 core review after unit 16 and independent native sentence/listening review.

uninspected: Guessed official measure.html failed. MIT transcript and Bunpro という点から考えると were search leads only and not used as inspected source evidence.
